M16 — 2026-10-11
The vitest suite is hermetic (vitest.config.ts, r4-fixes A13): CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and HOME point at a scratch root, so no test can read the real ~/.claude/sessions registry. packages/engine/test/livefire.peers.test.ts is therefore always skipped, even inside a Claude Code session. A live registry proof has to run outside vitest, e.g. an esbuild bundle of the engine source run with node.
